notes.title: Super Kill-BOI 9000 Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hey humans, 
it's been a couple of days since launch, and we've been receiving some great feedback! We want to say thank you to everyone who has bought the game, and especially those who have taken the time to write a review. If you haven't posted one yet, again, it would support us so much if you did. <3 

This first patch fixes some bugs, and adds a new mechanic: Friendship Bonuses!
When you level up Kill-BOI, a random Friendship Bonus is added to every upgrade. This way, you can increase different stats and shape your build more precisely! 

Please let us know how you like the changes - and have fun!

Here's the full changelog for version 1.1.0:

[b]Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added randomized FRIENDSHIP BONUSES to upgrades (this should make picking upgrades more varied and interesting)
[*] Every attack now has a crit chance
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Exploder now deal reduced damage when you are far away from the explosion center
[*] Improved Mini Flamethrower turn rate and damage
[*] Improved Shotgun turn rate
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Player can no longer get the same upgrade multiple times by mashing
[*] Fixed Gravinades spamming “0” damage numbers
[*] Fixed “Massive Saws” not working
[*] Cursor is now hidden when playing with controller or keyboard
[/list]

notes.title: Super KIll-BOI 9000 is OUT NOW! 🎉
notes.content:
Bois and girls - the time has come! The full version of Super KIll-BOI 9000 is now available!

Thanks to everyone who played the demo, to those who provided feedback, and to everyone who is buying a copy of the game!

By the way, we made a very stupid release trailer:
[previewyoutube=V3gW7eg4-fY;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to support us, you can write a positive review on Steam - it gives the BOI more visibility!
Have fun making a toaster killing machine!

- PlayWithFurcifer

notes.title: Added new maps & enemies!
notes.content:
Version 0.3.0 brings two new maps: the Moon and the Jungle with their own fauna to fight!

Full changelog:
[list]
[*] ADDED TWO MAPS (Jungle and Moon)
[*] ADDED TWO NEW ENEMY TYPES (Exploder and Birds)
[*] Added two map events
[*] Added shadows for player and Kill-BOI
[*] Increased player movement speed a bit, especially when carrying
[*] Improved weather effects
[*] Added knockback when the player takes damage
[*] Added lowpass filter to music on levelup screen/ options, because it sounds cool
[*] Fixed a bug softlocking the game when the player quit the run on the upgrade screen
[*] Fixed enemies sometimes spawning with wrong rotations
[*] Some more fixes
[/list]

Have fun and feel free to leave us feedback!
